newsitem.title: USA: Medical Graphics names new chairman, CEO.
newsitem.headline: Medical Graphics names new chairman, CEO.

text.p: As part of a broad restructuring, Medical Graphics Corp said Mark Sheffert was named chairman, replacing company founder Catherine Anderson, who resigned that post and her position as a director.
The board also named Glenn Taylor to the posts of president and chief executive effective immediately.
Taylor, 44, was formerly president and chief operating officer of Avecor Cardiovascular Inc.
Sheffert is chairman and chief executive officer of Manchester Cos Inc and was retained by the board to design and implement the restructuring plan.
The board also elected two new directors -- Taylor and John Wunsch, chief executive of Family Financial Strategies, a Minneapolis-based investment advisory firm.
The board also accepted the resignation of Wayne Faris as secretary of the corporation and director. Faris had been a director since 1990.
Taylor replaced Eric Sivertson, who resigned in January, when the company announced it expected to report a loss in its fourth quarter.
